content: Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
Esekiɛli, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ rɑ mɔn teni ko bu nɛɛ,
Adɑmɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ sere kɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru, i ǹ mɑɑ mɔn teni ɡerumɔ Isireliɔ.
Geemɑ, nɛnɑ nɑ bɑɑwuren wɑ̃ɑru nɛni, bɑɑbɑ kɑ bii. Yen sɔ̃, wi u torɑ wiyɑ u koo ɡbi.
Su tɛ̃ nɛɛ, ɡoo u wɑ̃ɑ u ɡeɑ mɔ̀, win dɑɑ yɑ wɑ̃.
U ku rɑ de ɡunɡunɔ u bũu sɑ̃. U ku rɑ mɑɑ bũu yɑ̃kunu di. U ku rɑ kɑ ɡoon kurɔ mɛnnɛ. Mɛyɑ u ku rɑ mɑɑ kɑ tɔn kurɔ mɛnnɛ sɑnɑm mɛ u yɑsɑ mɔ̀.
U ku rɑ ɡoo ɡbɛni. U ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡoo sɔmburu koosie kɑm. U rɑ wi u win dibu nɛni win tɔrubɑ wesie. U rɑ wi ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ mɔ̀ dĩɑnu wɛ̃. Kpɑ u wi u tereru sĩimɔ yɑ̃nu wɛ̃.
U ku rɑ tɔnu ɡobi bɔkure u nim doke. U ku rɑ n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ weesun swɑɑ sɔɔ. U rɑ siriwɑ dee dee, u bɑɑwure nùn win ɡem wɛ̃.
U rɑ nɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ mɑm mɑm. Tɔnu win bweserɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ rɑ soku ɡemɡii. Win wɑ̃ɑrɑ tɑ koo dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
Su mɑɑ tɛ̃ nɛɛ, durɔ wi, u bii mɔ wi u rɑ tɔmbu wɔri u ɡo, u ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ, ǹ kun mɛ u rɑ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑɑ ko.
N deemɑ win bɑɑbɑ ku rɑ yen bweseru ko. Bii wi, u rɑ bũu yɑ̃kuru de ɡunɡunɔ. U rɑ kɑ ɡɑbun kurɔbu mɛnnɛ.
U rɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ sɔmburu koosie kɑm. U rɑ tɔmbu ɡbɛni. U ku rɑ be u tɔrubɑ mwɑɑri ye wesie. U rɑ bũnu sɑ̃, kpɑ u n kom bɛrɛtɛkɛ mɔ̀.
U rɑ tɔmbu ɡobi bɔkure u nim doke. N weenɛ tɔnu win bweseru u n wɑ̃ɑ? Aɑwo, u koo ɡbiwɑ. Domi u dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ. Win yɛm mu koo wɔriwɑ win tii sɔɔ.
Su tɛ̃ nɛɛ, bii wi, u seewɑ u mɑrɑ. Mɑ win bii u seewɑ u win tundon torɑnu kpuro wɑ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ win tundon yirɑ ye swĩi.
U ku rɑ bũu yɑ̃kunu de ɡunɡunɔ. U ku rɑ bũnu sɑ̃ ni Isirelibɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ. U ku rɑ kɑ ɡoon kurɔ mɛnnɛ.
U ku rɑ ɡoo sɔmburu koosie kɑm. U ku rɑ be bɑ win dibu nɛni tɔrubɑ mwɑɑri. U ku rɑ ɡbɛni. U rɑ wi ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ mɔ̀ dĩɑnu wɛ̃. Kpɑ u wi u tereru sĩimɔ yɑ̃nu wɛ̃.
U ku rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ weesun swɑɑ sɔɔ. U ku rɑ tɔnu ɡobi bɔkure u nim doke. U rɑ nɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ. Bii wi, u ǹ ɡbimɔ win tundon torɑnun sɔ̃. U ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kɑ ɡem.
Adɑmɑ tundo wiyɑ u koo ɡbi win torɑnun sɔ̃ domi u tɔmbu tɔ̃yɑ kuɑ u ɡbɛnɑ.
I bikiɑmɔ i mɔ̀, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ bii kun win tundon durum ɑre sɔɔmɔ. Geemɑ, bii kun ye sɔɔmɔ yèn sɔ̃ u ɡeɑ kuɑ. Mɑ u sĩɑ dee dee nɛn yirɑ sɔɔ, u nɛn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ mɑm mɑm. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ko n wɑ̃ɑ.

Wi u torɑ, wiyɑ u koo ɡbi. Bibu bɑ ǹ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn torɑnun ɑre sɔɔmɔ. Mɛyɑ bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ben bibun torɑnun ɑre sɔɔmɔ. Kon ɡemɡii nùn win ɑre wɛ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u kom ɡem kuɑ. Kpɑ n mɑɑ tɔn kɔ̃so sɛɛyɑsiɑ yèn sɔ̃ u kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ.
Kɔ̃sɑn kirɔ
Tɔn kɔ̃so ù n win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ deri, mɑ u ɡem swĩi nɡe mɛ nɛn woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ kpuro, u ǹ mɑɑ ɡbimɔ.
Kon win torɑnu kpuro duɑri, kpɑ n de u n wɑ̃ɑ ɡeɑ ye u mɔ̀n sɔ̃.
I tɑmɑɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ kĩ tɔn kɔ̃so u ɡbi? Aɑwo. Ye nɑ kĩ, yerɑ u ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ kpɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ.
Adɑmɑ wi u ɡem deri, mɑ u dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀ nɡe tɔn kɔ̃so, i tɑmɑɑ u ko n wɑ̃ɑ? Aɑwo. Kon win yellun dɑɑ ɡeɑ ye duɑriwɑ kpɑ n de u ɡbi win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kɑ win mɛm nɔɔ sɑrirun sɔ̃.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, i mɔ̀, nɛn ɡere ye, yɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee. I swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. Nɛn ɡerewɑ yɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee? Nɡe bɛɛyɑ i sɑkɑ sɑrɑmɔ.
Gemɡii ù n ɡeɑ deri, mɑ u kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀, u koo ɡbiwɑ kɔ̃sɑ yen sɔ̃.
Tɔn kɔ̃so ù n mɑɑ win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ deri, mɑ u dɑɑ ɡeɑ mɔ̀, u win wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑmɔwɑ.
U ko n wɑ̃ɑ, domi u ɡiɑ mɑ kɔ̃sɑ u rɑɑ mɔ̀, mɑ u ye deri. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, u ǹ mɑɑ ɡbimɔ.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ i mɔ̀, nɛn ɡere yɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ dee dee. Adɑmɑ n ǹ mɛ, bɛɛyɑ i sɑkɑ sɑrɑmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, kon bɑɑwure siriwɑ nɡe mɛ win dɑɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i bɛɛn dɑɑ kɔsio i kɔ̃sɑ deri. I ku de bɛɛn dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ yu bɛɛ kɑm koosiɑ.
I bɛɛn dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ derio kpɑ i bɛɛn ɡɔ̃run bwisikunu ɡɔsiɑ. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ko i tii ɡo.
I yɛ̃ mɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ ǹ ɡoon ɡɔɔ kĩ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsio kpɑ i wɑ i n wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbu
ɡɔɔ wuri kuɑmmɛ
